checklist.text: The three bars run down on a selected bird
Birds nap in the afternoon (Roost pose, z's) and get up again
A thirsty bird far from the pool flies over and drinks until full; one nearby walks
After rain, thirsty birds use a nearer puddle
Night Owls settle or leave in the morning and come back toward dusk
No Night Owl arrives at midday
A Dabbler shows up and bathes far more than it sips
Quit with birds napping and reload: still napping
An old save loads with every bird's needs rolled
The bird card fits on your screen

description: Food, Water and Rest bars on the bird card, afternoon naps, thirsty birds fly or walk to the water, Night Owls sleep by day, and a new Dabbler trait. Session 34. This reverses the Oct 26 and Oct 29 decisions not to have these needs.
title: 5.10 Thirst and rest needs
